# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine years old (at the end of Volume 3)  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c7 P15](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c7 P15](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Avonlea School  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004), [v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034)</sub>; A limb  <sub>[v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c9 P23](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0023)</sub>; A reformed character  <sub>[v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned, handsome boy with a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets all over his round head and roguish, dancing hazel eyes. He has a snub nose, a smiling mouth, and a comical dimple in one cheek. He is somewhat wide in build and possesses an appetite that makes him grow rapidly.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v3 c7 P15](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0015)_

## Personality

Davy is an exuberant, inquisitive, and mischievous boy who is constantly 'wanting to know' about the world around him. Though frequently getting into trouble through sheer restlessness or thoughtlessness, he possesses an affectionate and impulsive nature that wins the hearts of those around him. He is extremely honest about his misdeeds when confronted, and harbors a deep desire to be loved. Despite his naughty antics, he is fiercely loyal to those he cares about and works hard to improve his behavior for their sake.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned when their mother, Mary Keith, died of consumption. Their distant relative Marilla Cuthbert took them into Green Gables for the winter at Anne's urging. Davy quickly established a reputation for chaotic mischief, dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, locking his sister in a toolhouse, and dropping a toad into Marilla's bed. Despite his wild pranks, Anne's loving approach and patience helped him learn right from wrong, particularly when he confessed to telling falsehoods and promised never to do so again. Upon the death of his uncle, Richard Keith, a trust fund was established for Davy and Dora, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables. Davy enrolled at Avonlea School, where he formed a friendship with Milty Boulter and gradually reformed his mischievous behavior, growing deeply attached to Anne and Marilla.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P37](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0037), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031)_

- Son of Mary Keith and third cousin once removed to Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P35](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0035)</sub>
- Father died when he was a baby and mother died of consumption when he was six  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Adopted into Green Gables after his mother's death  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
